name: grep
description: Search the git project for a literal string and return matching file paths, line numbers, and lines. By default the search is limited to the files changed by the current patch set; pass scope="project" to search the whole repository at this patch set. A miss in the default scope is not evidence that a symbol does not exist: repeat the search with scope="project" before concluding that a declaration, import or route is missing.

string.description: Literal string to search for in the git project.

scope.description: Search space. "change" (default) searches only the files changed by the current patch set; "project" searches the whole repository at this patch set.
